{"turns": [
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "hi, my internet is down again!! 😡", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Hello! Thanks for contacting Nimbus Telecom. I'm Ravi. How can I help you today?", "tags": ["greeting"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "my wifi is barely working and i cant even load a page. its so frustrating", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "I am sorry to hear that you're experiencing these connection issues. I know how annoying it is when your internet is slow.", "tags": ["empathy"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "exactly. i just want it fixed now.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "I can definitely look into this for you. Could you please provide your account number and full name for verification?", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "My name is Michael Mehta, account number 53773065.", "tags": ["identity_verification"]},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Thank you, Mr. Mehta. Let me check the line status for your area. One moment please.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "hope it works. my phone is 99206 73058 if you need it.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Thanks. I see a signal drop in your neighborhood. It looks like a network fault in the local hub.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "so what happens now? i need it for work", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "I will raise a network ticket right now to get our engineers to prioritize the repair in your area.", "tags": ["action:technician_or_ticket"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "oh okay, that sounds good. thanks for the quick response Ravi", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today? I've raised the ticket and the engineers will update the status. Goodbye!", "tags": ["closure"]}
]}
